description: This file defines the CallbackFileWrapper class, which is a wrapper around an HTTPResponse object that buffers the data as it is read, stores it in a temporary file, and executes a callback with the content upon closure. It is used for handling HTTP response streams with potential buffering and callback execution.

classes.name: CallbackFileWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class that combines temporary file buffering with callback execution upon closing the file stream.

methods.name: None __init__( self, fp: HTTPResponse, callback: Callable[[bytes], None] | None )
methods.description: Initializes the wrapper with an HTTPResponse and an optional callback function, setting up a temporary file for buffering data.

methods.name: Any __getattr__(self, name: str)
methods.description: Delegates attribute access to the underlying HTTPResponse object.

methods.name: bool __is_fp_closed(self)
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped file pointer (fp) is closed.

methods.name: None _close(self)
methods.description: Finalizes buffering, executes the callback with buffered data, and closes temporary resources.

methods.name: bytes read(self, amt: int | None = None)
methods.description: Reads data from the wrapped response, writes to buffer, and closes if response is finished.

methods.name: bytes _safe_read(self, amt: int)
methods.description: Performs a safe read, handling specific cases like CRLF termination, writes data to buffer, and manages closure.
